text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japanese Oaks. We
arrive early
and are heading to the
waiting room, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but do we have some time before
we head
in?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to have a look at the course
before I run.
Is there time?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув seems more nervous than
usual. I
decide to okay her request.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The first race hasn't even yet begun, but
the
stands are quite full already.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're gonna witness history today! I
wanna see
the Empress follow in her
mom's footsteps and
win the Japanese
Oaks with my own eyes!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
You said it! I really, really hope Air
Groove wins!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
It's evident that the crowd has a
heightened
interest in today's race—or
perhaps I should say,
in Эйр Грув's
performance today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what was going through my
mother's
mind when she took on the
Japanese Oaks.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
How strange... To be here myself, yet
thinking of
that.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув has a point—it's not like her
to be so
pensive.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You've never asked her about it?

text_block_list.text:
Once, but I was quite young at the time.
I
remember how she responded even
now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
"If you really want to know, then try
running there
yourself."
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
"If you give the race everything you can
muster,
I'm sure you'll understand how I
felt." That's what
she told me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...What's with that look?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: You strike me as pretty different from her.

text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the big questions, my
mother
doesn't like to hand out answers.
She believes it's
more effective to let
you find them for yourself.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
She has a broad outlook that I can't
hope to
fathom, and her words always
have a deeper
meaning.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's only natural that you wouldn't
understand her
words. Especially when I
myself am still puzzling
over them.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's tone is as abrasive as ever,
but her
expression is slightly softer than
usual when
speaking of her mother. She
looks almost...
childlike.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together with the new perspective on
what the
Japanese Oaks means to her, it
makes me see her
in a new light.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
I guess in the end, you'll just have to try it and
see.

text_block_list.text:
Heh. To think you'd be the one to tell
me that.
But you're absolutely right.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll do exactly as my mother said and
give this
race everything I can muster.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone that I can catch the
queen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for wasting your time with this.
Let's get
ready.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's that time of the year when nature
blooms into
the fullness of its beauty!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Which of these dazzling young stars will
take the
crown and become Queen of
the Oaks?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Many eyes are cast upon Эйр Грув!
Can she
follow in her mother's
footsteps?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We can hear the cheers from the crowd
even here.
Now, as for Эйр Грув...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...All right.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Her state of intense focus gives her a
more
dignified air than I've ever seen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I know. I'm going to surpass everyone's
wildest
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: The race is about to begin!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
